entities.name: Heinrich von Prittwitz und Gaffron
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Heinrich von Prittwitz und Gaffron was a general officer in the Heer (Army) branch of the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany during World War II. He was commander of the 14th and 15th Panzer Divisions and was killed in action in the early stages of the Siege of Tobruk.
